text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*, *wheeze*, quite the turn of foot you got there,
Shakir.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha, congratulations!
Shall I dance a celebratory jig for you?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"I don't need it!!
There's not a damn thing funny about this!!"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Even if I won. A victory that wasn't part of the plan
don't make me happy in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Geez, sticking your nose in just 'cause you felt like it.

And so, Tap Dance City headed back
to the underground tunnel—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you were right on the money!
Shakar really was my biggest rival today.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"We didn't win, but this result is
not too bad. ...Right?"
"Running the Classic Triple Crown was originally meant to prove my strength."

"With this Satsuki Sho, there was no doubt
that the name Tap Dance City and her hidden potential became widely known."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta make 'em realize
just how terrifying a notorious captain can be.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Whoops, bad rep is no good, huh? Ahahaha!
Anyway, let's keep heavily promoting it!

Even in defeat, Tap Dance City
remained full of fighting spirit.
